youtube_description:
Welcome to INVENTORY, FlyQuest's new interview series where we invite one of our organization's personalities to strike up conversation sparked by objects or moments of significance to them.

In this episode LCS Top Laner Bwipo talks about how he started playing League, why Kai'Sa is significant to him and how the game is all numbers but he's terrible at maths.
